name: Behalf.bot - Perplexity research briefs
description: Turn a research question into a citation-solid .epub brief. Runs a designed set of scholar-filtered queries through a Perplexity session driven by Playwright, harvests the real citation URLs the accessibility tree hides, synthesizes a sectioned brief with an inline DOI on every claim and a source-summary table, and builds it to epub with pandoc. Optional deep path appends the full text of every cited article via a scrape-with-fallbacks chain. Delivery targets are pluggable: a file on disk, a chat message, or an e-reader.

enabled.description: Master switch. Off by default: the pipeline needs a signed-in Perplexity account driven through browser automation, which is an operator decision rather than a default.

research_ui_url.description: Base URL of the research interface driven by Playwright. Swappable for any search UI that renders an answer plus a sources panel; the harvest step keys on real anchor hrefs rather than a specific DOM.

source_filter.description: Query-string source filter appended to every search URL. 'scholar' restricts to peer-reviewed sources, which is the whole point for a science brief. Empty string disables filtering. Consumed as RESEARCH_SOURCE_FILTER.

queries_per_brief.description: Target number of distinct queries per brief. Each becomes one section and has to carry a defensible citation on its own. Below 4 the brief is thin; above 6 the sections start restating each other.

output_dir.description: Directory that receives the brief markdown and the built .epub. Consumed as RESEARCH_OUTPUT_DIR.

scratch_dir.description: Directory for the per-query Playwright JSON dumps. Kept out of the repo root on purpose: the browser tool writes these wherever it is pointed, and a default of 'here' is how they end up committed. Cleaned at the end of a run. Consumed as RESEARCH_SCRATCH_DIR.

author_line.description: Author metadata stamped into the epub. Placeholders ${ASSISTANT_NAME} and ${PRINCIPAL_NAME} are expanded from the chassis identity config.

language.description: BCP 47 language tag written into the brief's frontmatter and the epub metadata.

pandoc_bin.description: Path to the pandoc binary. Left as a bare name so PATH resolution wins; set an absolute path where PATH is not reliable. Consumed as RESEARCH_PANDOC_BIN.

toc_depth.description: Table-of-contents depth passed to pandoc. Consumed as RESEARCH_TOC_DEPTH.

delivery_targets.description: Where a finished brief goes. 'file' leaves it in output_dir and reports the path. 'chat' posts it with the caveats summary. 'ereader' hands the epub to ereader_send_command. Multiple targets are delivered in order, and a failure in one does not abort the others.

delivery_channel_id.description: Chat channel id for the 'chat' delivery target. No default and no fallback: an unset value must fail loudly rather than post a research brief into whatever channel happens to be first. Sourced from the chassis surface config as DISCORD_PRIMARY_CHANNEL_ID unless overridden here.

brief_base_url.description: Optional HTTP base under which output_dir is served, e.g. an internal file host. When set, the chat delivery includes a direct link alongside the attachment so the brief survives a flaky mobile download. Empty by default because most installs serve nothing. Consumed as RESEARCH_BRIEF_BASE_URL.

ereader_send_command.description: Command invoked with the epub path as its single argument for the 'ereader' delivery target. Intentionally a command rather than a hardwired integration, so any e-reader with a CLI works. Installs running the companion reMarkable plugin point this at its send script. Consumed as RESEARCH_EREADER_SEND_COMMAND.

deep_path_warn_mb.description: Projected appendix size above which the operator is warned before the fetch loop starts. The estimate is roughly 300 KB per open-access paper. Consumed as RESEARCH_DEEP_WARN_MB.

deep_path_split_mb.description: Projected size above which the default action becomes splitting into two epubs (brief, appendix) rather than one. E-reader software tends to choke on very large single files. Consumed as RESEARCH_DEEP_SPLIT_MB.

activation._note: On-demand only. Invoked when the operator asks for research on a topic or a revision of a prior brief. No scheduled jobs - a research brief nobody asked for is a brief nobody reads.

system.name: pandoc
system.install: apt-get install pandoc (Debian) / your platform's package manager
system._explanation: Builds the markdown brief into epub with a table of contents. Hard dependency: the epub IS the deliverable.

system.name: Playwright browser automation
system.install: provided by the chassis browser tooling
system._explanation: Drives the research UI. The session must already be signed in - the plugin never handles credentials for it, and an unauthenticated session gets a degraded free-tier answer with fewer sources rather than an error.

system.name: poppler-utils
system.install: apt-get install poppler-utils (Debian) / your platform's package manager
system._explanation: Soft dependency, deep path only. pdftotext rescues PDFs that the scraper returns garbled. Its absence loses one rung of the appendix fallback chain and nothing else.
